The Norfolk city charter, Section 18, states that municipal elections are held at the November general election beginning in 2022 and every second year thereafter. It states that the elections for the mayor and superwards six and seven are held at the November 2024 general election and every four years thereafter. The next regular mayoral election is therefore November 2028, and none falls in 2025. The official results index for 2025 lists only the June 17, 2025 Democratic Party primary election, which is not a mayoral contest. The index does not list a November 2025 general election. The charter text opened does not state the 2020 election date; the earlier May election dates come from the results documents.

The city list of qualified candidates for the November 3, 2026 general election shows ward council and school board races and no mayoral office.
